lightNovel.cizgi: Rudeus GreyratSylphietteNanahoshi ShizukaElinaliseCliff Grimoire
lightNovel.ozet: WEDDED BLISS—OR BANE?! A new chapter of Rudeus’ life beckons as he throws himself into his research, house-hunting, and planning a wedding. But then an unexpected letter, bearing shocking news, arrives to interrupt the young couple’s domestic dreams.

lightNovel.cizgi: Rudeus GreyratNorn GreyratAisha GreyratZanobaJulie
lightNovel.ozet: LITTLE SISTERS MAKE BIG PROBLEMS! Rudeus has adventured across continents and survived run-ins with gods—and none of it has prepared him to watch Aisha and Norn when Paul leaves them temporarily in his care. Can he rise to the occasion yet again, or will parenting two preteen girls be the ordeal that ultimately defeats him?!

lightNovel.cizgi: Rudeus GreyratElinaliseGeeseTallhandPaul GreyratRoxy Migurdia
lightNovel.ozet: Father and Son Brave The Labyrinth! Rudeus and Paul must descend into the deadly depths of a Teleportation Labyrinth to rescue Zenith. The father-son duo makes short work of deadly beasts and ancient magical traps, but it’s the terrible truth at the Labyrinth’s heart that proves the greatest threat of all.

lightNovel.cizgi: Rudeus GreyratSylphiette GreyratRoxy M. GreyratNorn GreyratLucy GreyratAisha GreyratLilia GreyratZenith Greyrat
lightNovel.ozet:
AN EX-GIRLFRIEND COMES TO TOWN

Putting loss and grief behind them, Rudeus and his two wives are ready to settle into polygamous bliss–until an old flame arrives, stirring up old memories. Will the Greyrat family ever achieve the domesticity they hope for? Or are they doomed to be dogged by drama all their days?

lightNovel.cizgi: Rudeus GreyratSylvarilAtoferatofe RaibakuPerugius DolaNanahoshi Shizuka
lightNovel.ozet:
CASTLE IN THE SKY

Nanahoshi, Rudeus, and the rest of their group take a trip to Perugius Dola’s mysterious floating fortress, seeking adventure and a once-in-a-lifetime chance to learn new magic. What they find instead is disaster as one of their members is struck down by a deadly illness. How far will Rudeus go to save a dear friend’s life?

lightNovel.cizgi: Rudeus GreyratEris GreyratOrsted
lightNovel.ozet: |-|English (MF Books)=THAT ERIS IS BACK!? OVERCOME THE PAST AND PROTECT YOUR FAMILY!Rudeus encounters his old self, who has traveled back in time from the future. He decides to defeat the dragon god Orsted at Hitogami's suggestion in order to avoid the route his future self has taken, which would cause him to lose all of his loved ones.

lightNovel.cizgi: Rudeus GreyratSylphiette GreyratEris GreyratLuke Notos GreyratAriel Anemoi Asura
lightNovel.ozet:
|-|English (MF Books)=FIRST MISSION AS A SUBORDINATENow Rudeus has Eris as his wife and is under the control of dragon Orsted. By summoning a magical beast to protect the house, he was able to recover his peaceful days for the time being. One day,  Orsted give him his first mission, "make Ariel, the second princess of the Asura kingdom, Queen."

Rudeus and his friends go to the Library Labyrinth in search of hints on how to get the backing of Perugius.

lightNovel.cizgi: Rudeus GreyratLuke Notos GreyratAriel Anemoi AsuraReida ReiaAuber Corvette
lightNovel.ozet:
MISSION AGAINST HITOGAMI AND HIS APOSTLES 

It's been a few weeks since they returned from the library labyrinth. Rudeus accompanies Ariel to the Asura Kingdom to complete the Mission in making Ariel queen. In preparation for the decisive battle, the group prepares the stage at the royal castle of Ars.

lightNovel.cizgi: Rudeus GreyratAisha GreyratNorn GreyratLinia Dedoldia
lightNovel.ozet:
RUDEUS TRAVELS AROUND THE WORLD

Rudeus completes his first mission to make Ariel the next King of Asura Kingdom. Since then, a year and a half has passed, receiving numerous missions from Orsted, and when he returned to his house, he purchased her old senpai Linia from a slave merchant. One day, a letter arrives from the Doldia village to Rinia ["Urgent, the Holy Beast is missing!

lightNovel.cizgi: Rudeus GreyratZanobaRoxy M. GreyratGingerRandolph Marianne
lightNovel.ozet:
ZANOBA'S HOMECOMING

A letter has arrived from the Kingdom of Shirone to Zanoba, asking him to return home. It seems that they need defense forces to make up for the troops that have fallen due to a coup d'etat in the kingdom. Rudeus realizes that the content of the letter is a trap by Hitogami.

lightNovel.cizgi: Rudeus GreyratEris Boreas GreyratSauros Boreas GreyratPhilip Boreas GreyratGhislaine Dedoldia
lightNovel.ozet: |-|English (MF Books)=THE SECOND INSTALLMENT OF THE LONG AWAITED REINCARNATION FANTASY HAS ALREADY ARRIVED! A 34-year-old man who was unemployed and a NEET before his birth has been reborn in a different world and is starting a new life. Rudeus was given a job as a tutor for a young lady living in the largest city in the Fittoa territory, Roa.

lightNovel.cizgi: Rudeus GreyratZenith GreyratAisha GreyratCliff Grimoire
lightNovel.ozet:
CLIFF HOMECOMING

Rudeus returns with Zanoba from Shirone Kingdom to Ranoa Kingdom. One day, a letter arrives to Cliff, who is graduating from the Magic University of Sharia, from his grandfather in Millis. As with Zanoba, he suspected that may be a trap of Hitogami.

lightNovel.cizgi: Rudeus GreyratMikoClaire LatreiaZenith Greyrat
lightNovel.ozet:
ZENITH IS KIDNAPPED

Zenith was abducted by someone and disappeared. Rudeus scrambles the city of Millishion to find her. "I am the son of Zenith.

lightNovel.cizgi: Rudeus GreyratRoxy M. GreyratEris GreyratAtoferatofe Raibaku
lightNovel.ozet:
REUNION WITH PAST ENEMIES

An apostle of Hitogami, who had been hiding until now, was finally discovered. Rudeus, who is now gathering his strength to fight, decides to persuade Atofe, the immortal demon king who reigns in the Demon Continent to make her a powerful ally. However, negotiations are difficult for the group of Rudeus.

lightNovel.cizgi: Rudeus GreyratSylphiette GreyratSieghart GreyratRoxy M. GreyratEris Greyrat
lightNovel.ozet:
TO THE HEAVENS: THE TRIAL OF PERUGIUS

The fourth child Sieghard was born, with the same green hair as Laplace. However, one of the Perugius familiars who witnessed the scene, told to Rudeus and the others to come to the sky citadel with the baby. "If this kid grows up and really causes a war with the human race then I will deal with it ...

lightNovel.cizgi: Rudeus Greyrat Norn Greyrat Cliff Grimoire Elinalise Ruijerd Superdia
lightNovel.ozet:
SEEKING SUPPORT

Rudeus arrives at Irel City in Biheiril Kingdom to request Ruijerd’s support in his battle against Geese. The road to Ruijerd is a bumpy one, but after ten long years apart they finally reunite. Will Rudeus’s impassioned pleas for aid in the Laplace War reach Ruijerd’s heart?

lightNovel.cizgi: Rudeus GreyratEris GreyratRuijerd SuperdiaKalman IIKalman IIIGal Farion
lightNovel.ozet: DEAD END AGAIN! WHO WILL BE THE WINNER OF THE DECISIVE BATTLE? While the communication tablet and the transfer magic circle in the various locations stop functioning, Rudeus and his friends gather at the village of the Superd tribe.

lightNovel.baslik: Cilt 26 — The Final Battle ArcConclusion Arc
lightNovel.cizgi: Rudeus GreyratSylphiette GreyratRoxy M. GreyratEris GreyratNorn GreyratAisha GreyratArs GreyratLucy GreyratChristina GreyratSieghart Saladin GreyratLara GreyratLily GreyratLilia GreyratZenith Greyrat
lightNovel.ozet: THE LAST PAGE OF RUDEUS’S TALE The final disciple of the Man-God appears alongside the treacherous Geese: Badigadi. Equipped with Laplace’s Fighting God Armor and an unparalleled ability to regenerate his body, Badigadi promises a vicious, no-holds-barred fight to the death like Rudeus’s team has never seen before. Rudeus’s lifelong war against the Man-God is almost over—what will be left when the dust clears?

lightNovel.cizgi: Rudeus GreyratEris Boreas GreyratRuijerd SuperdiaNokoparaJalilRoxy Migurdia (SP)
lightNovel.ozet: |-|English (MF Books)=GET YOUR BELOVED FAMILY BACK. THE THIRD INSTALLMENT OF THE "START YOUR LIFE OVER" FANTASY SERIES! Rudeus, an unemployed NEET, is separated from his family when he gets caught up in an unexplained magical disaster.

lightNovel.cizgi: Rudeus GreyratEris Boreas GreyratRuijerd SuperdiaKishirika Kishirisu
lightNovel.ozet:
EYES OF THE DEMON

Continuing their journey, Rudeus, Eris and Ruijerd have a run in with a figure from legend–none other than the Great Emperor of the Demon World, Kishirika herself! When the trio lend her their aid, Kishrika rewards Rudy with a strange new power…one that might just be more than he bargained for.

lightNovel.cizgi: Rudeus GreyratEris Boreas GreyratNorn GreyratPaul Greyrat
lightNovel.ozet:
FATHER VS. SON

Rudeus and his party arrive in Millishion, capital of the Holy Country of Millis—only to find themselves tangled up with yet another attempted kidnapping. But the real shock comes when the kidnappers’ very familiar boss shows up on the scene.

lightNovel.cizgi: Rudeus GreyratEris Boreas GreyratAisha GreyratLilia GreyratRuijerd Superdia
lightNovel.ozet:
A ROYAL MESS

A tip from the enigmatic Man God leads to the Shirone Kingdom, where Lilia and Aisha are being held captive in the palace. Rudeus and company head to the rescue—only to get swept up in some nasty, unfinished business Roxy left in her wake! Family reunions are one thing, but can Dead End deal with saying goodbye to one of their own?

lightNovel.cizgi: Rudeus GreyratSaraSoldat HecklerSuzanneTimothyMimir
lightNovel.ozet:
THE MOTHER OF ALL ADVENTURES

Alone and forlorn, Rudeus arrives at the city of Rosenburg to search for his mother, Zenith. Despite his attempts to focus on the task at hand, Eris’ absence weighs heavy on his heart, and so Rudeus gambles on a dangerous new venture to distract himself from his newfound loneliness—accepting an A-rank job all by himself.

lightNovel.cizgi: Rudeus GreyratFitzPursena AdoldiaLinia Dedoldia
lightNovel.ozet:
BACK TO SCHOOL

A letter for Rudeus arrives out of the blue, bearing an invitation to enroll at the Ranoa University of Magic. The admissions exam is a cakewalk, but once Rudeus is accepted, a far less straightforward challenge awaits him—getting to know his eccentric new classmates!

lightNovel.ozet: BLAST FROM THE PAST! Life at the Ranoa University of Magic suddenly gets more interesting when Rudeus discovers the mysterious Fitz’s true identity. What will this unforeseen reunion bring?

ekstra.ozet:
本編のその後を描く物語集『蛇足編』、堂々完結！ビヘイリル王国での決戦の末、勝利したルーデウス・グレイラット。彼と彼を取り巻く人々のその後を描く物語集『蛇足編』。シリーズ最終巻となる第四巻では、ルーデウスとシルフィの娘ルーシーの結婚にまつわる書き下ろしエピソード『ルーシーの憂鬱』、空中城塞に住まうナナホシの視点でルーデウスたちとの定期的な交流が描かれる『ナナホシのグルメ』に加え、子どもたちの独り立ちを描く『最後の巣立ち』の三編を収録。決戦の後にも人生は続く――そして思いが語られる。「こんなに、人としてちゃんと生きられるとは、思っていなかった」人生やり直し型転生ファンタジー、本編のその後を紡ぐ物語集、ここに堂々完結！
